review.why: Diagnoses broken n8n workflows in order of likelihood: parameters, stale assumptions, wiring, stripped upstream data, lost item context, logic, bugs.
review.summary: Lists seven likely causes with a cheap check for each, then an eight-step walkthrough: confirm the symptom, read the execution, re-fetch the workflow and node types, test with pinned data, read the n8n source, suspect version drift and report. Its one rule is to believe the user and say I don't know yet rather than invent a cause.
strengths: Ordered checks from cheap to deep
Calls out the silent null from a node that replaced the data
Explicitly prefers I don't know yet to a fabricated cause
cautions: Needs n8n tools to fetch executions and workflows
Later steps and two reference files are not read here
Contains temporary notes about missing instance tools
